title: Swap Places
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq T \leq 1000; 2 \leq N \leq 2000; 1 \leq M \leq \min(\frac{N(N-1)}{2}, 2000); C_i \in \lbrace 0, 1 \rbrace; 1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq N; The graph given in the input is simple.; All values in the input are integers.; The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2000.; The sum of M over all test cases does not exceed 2000.
